about: NovoRapid FlexPen (insulin aspart, a rapid-acting insulin), by brand name only, is supplied five times from January to September 2026 to a 72-year-old man, and glucose determines the entire dose at each meal with no evidence of scheduled or background insulin in the supply history.

Humalog KwikPen (insulin lispro, a rapid-acting insulin) is supplied three times from December 2025 to April 2026 to a 67-year-old woman, in the middle of a 14-month history, and glucose determines the entire dose at each meal with no evidence of scheduled or background insulin in the supply history.
NovoRapid FlexPen (insulin aspart) is supplied five times, but every label gives a fixed dose of 6 units before each meal and no label mentions a sliding scale, so the criterion is not met.
